final_evidence_resolution_gateway.rationale: Digital scans remain useful custody-bound references, but connector/image limitations must not force permanent blockage. The exact physical textbook itself may become the inspected artifact, without treating the unrelated PDF as authenticated.

required: SHA-256 of exact inspected PDF bytes
NCTB authorization evidence attributable to that exact copy/edition
front-matter capture IDs and SHA-256 values
claim-page capture IDs and SHA-256 values

invariants: Physical-copy evidence does not authenticate a separate PDF scan.
Drive file ID/size/modified time is custody metadata, not a substitute for SHA-256.
Book-family corroboration is not exact-edition authentication.
Draft-remediation authority is not final lecture-gap remediation authority.
Pass 2 remains fail-closed until every required field for one artifact-identity mode is complete.
